name: @voltui/desktop-electron
description: 西谷智灯暗涌平台 desktop shell for the official DeepSeek Harness runtime

scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:main
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:profile && pnpm run test:runtime && pnpm run test:smb && pnpm run test:security
scripts.start: pnpm run install:electron && pnpm run stage:runtime && electron dist/main.js
scripts.dist: pnpm run install:electron && pnpm run stage:runtime && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mjs --win --x64 --publish never

author: 西谷智灯暗涌平台 contributors
